sections.heading: JD Vance — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: JD Vance was born on 2 August 1984 in Middletown, and holds American nationality. He was given the name James Donald Bowman at birth and is publicly known as JD Vance.
Public records name his father, Donald Ray Bowman.
He studied at Middletown High School, Ohio State University, Yale Law School and Yale University.
He is recorded as speaking American English, Appalachian English and English.

sections.heading: JD Vance — Career and Professional Work
paras: JD Vance works primarily as a writer, financier, pundit, politician, corporate lawyer and merchant, with Revolution LLC and Mithril Capital listed among his employers.
Among the credits most often linked to JD are Hillbilly Elegy and Rockbridge Network.
He has held the following offices: United States senator (2023–2025) and Vice President of the United States (2025–present). He is affiliated with Republican Party.
He has taken part in 2024 United States presidential election, 2024 Republican National Convention, Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign and United States government group chat leaks.
